labels.label: T-abs-hoist-lemma-k/lemma-k-models
findings: Library, not paper. The target's evidence names one model path for Causal.LemmaKBare (to Causal.Model.CurvesExtendModels). At HEAD it had three: Causal.Model.CurvesExtendModels and Causal.Model.Massive for its static section, and Causal.Splitting, which reaches Causal.Flat.IsomCausal. tools/ladder.py's model_path reports only the shortest chain. Moving the static section alone would have left LemmaKBare model-layer through Splitting. LemmaKBare needed nothing from Splitting except Causal.CauchyDual (dual_isCauchySurfaceOn), so `import Causal.Splitting` is replaced by `import Causal.CauchyDual`.

The alternative was one model module per source (e.g. Model/LemmaKBareModels, Model/LemmaKSCLocalModels). Splitting it later is a cut by line range.
